title: Admin & Marketing Assistant
description:
Admin & Marketing Assistant

Ascot

24,000 per annum ( 30,000 FTE)

4 days per week (Mon - Weds & Fri)

Our client is looking for an Admin & Marketing Assistant to join their well-established business in a varied role combining executive support, office administration and marketing. This role is ideal for a highly organised, proactive individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and supporting senior management.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage senior management diaries, coordinate meetings, and provide general executive support.
- Oversee daily office operations, ensuring the smooth running of the business.
- Organise business travel, meetings, and corporate engagements.
- Handle correspondence, confidential documents and business agreements.
- Manage social media platforms, creating content to increase brand awareness and engagement.
- Assist with website updates, online content, and marketing campaigns.
- Prepare sales and marketing materials, including brochures, email campaigns, and documentation.
- Collate information, assist with reporting, and provide general departmental support.

Key Requirements
- Previous experience in administration, PA, or office support.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional telephone manner.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, CRM systems, Teams, and Zoom.
- Experience using Canva or similar design tools and managing professional social media accounts.
- Proactive, adaptable, and confident working independently and within a team, with discretion when handling confidential information.

Full clean driving licence and own transport essential!

title: Content Creator
description:
We're looking for a creative and enthusiastic Content Creator to join the growing team at this fast-growing watch house.

Working closely with the Campaign Manager and in-house Design team, you'll play an important role in creating engaging content across social media channels and wider marketing campaigns.

You'll have a good eye for visual storytelling, be confident behind a camera and have the skills to turn footage and creative ideas into engaging content.

While working under the direction of the Campaign Manager, we're looking for someone who is comfortable taking a brief and working independently to deliver high-quality creative work.

This is a great opportunity for someone in the early stages of their creative career who is keen to develop their skills and grow with the business.

What You'll Be Doing

Content Creation
- Take a leading role in capturing, editing and producing content for social media channels.
- Create engaging photography and video content to support product launches, marketing campaigns, events and other brand communications.
- Film and edit content across a variety of formats, particularly short-form video for social media.
- Operate camera, lighting and sound equipment to produce high-quality content.
- Identify and contribute creative ideas for content that reflects this standout timepiece brand.

Creative Support
- Work alongside the in-house Design team to deliver creative briefs and produce supporting marketing assets.
- Use Adobe Creative Suite to edit photography, video and graphics.
- Adapt creative assets for different platforms and formats whilst maintaining brand consistency.
- Support the Campaign Manager with content requirements for upcoming campaigns and product launches.

Planning and Collaboration
- Work independently from creative briefs, managing your time and delivering work to agreed deadlines.
- Collaborate with the Campaign Manager and wider team to plan and organise content shoots.
- Help maintain an organised library of photography, video footage and creative assets.
- Attend and capture content at events, exhibitions and other brand activities across the UK and internationally, as required.

Experience and Skills

What We're Looking For
- Some relevant experience in content creation, videography, photography or a similar creative role.
- Confidence in operating cameras and using basic lighting and sound equipment.
- Experience editing video using Adobe Premiere Pro or similar software.
- Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.
- A good understanding of social media platforms and the types of content that work well across them.
- A creative eye, strong attention to detail and an interest in visual storytelling.
- The ability to interpret a brief and work independently to produce finished content.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects.
- A collaborative attitude, a willingness to learn and enthusiasm for developing creative skills.
- A willingness to travel within the UK and internationally when required.

What We Can Offer

You'll be joining our client at an exciting stage of its corporate growth, working alongside a small and ambitious creative team, reporting into the Campaign Manager.

Based in central Maidenhead, you'll have the opportunity to develop your skills, contribute to exciting product launches and create content for a growing international audience.

We're looking for someone who wants to take ownership of their work, develop their creative abilities and build a long-term career with this highly regarded business.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive - Global Brand, HYBRID!

Are you looking for the first step in your marketing career? If you are enthusiastic and passionate about Digital Marketing we would love to talk to you! NOW is your chance.

THE OPPORTUNITY:
- Our client is based in Bracknell and is looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join their team on an on-going temporary basis.
- This is a unique opportunity to gain experience working with a team of 30+ innovative marketers for a global organisation.
- The successful candidates will become experts in global and regional campaigns, content management and regularly update the content on the websites.
- To be considered all you need is a genuine interest in Digital Marketing and a willingness to learn.

JOB TITLE: Digital Marketing Executive
CONTRACT: Temporary, ongoing
HOURS: 09.00 am - 17.30 pm, Monday to Friday
START: ASAP
PAY RATE: £13.00 per hour
LOCATION: Bracknell, Berkshire

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- You will become an expert in global and regional campaigns, content management systems (CMS) and manage all changes on the websites.
- You will be supporting the team with the following activities:
- Small and large scale rollouts of content across 150 country sites
- Some ad hoc technical testing as part of release cycles, and deployments
- Support the orchestration of translation workflows via our translations tool with our translation teams and stakeholders
- Provide site wide SEO support to ensure the site remains high on search results
- Ensuring that all company standards are maintained and changes are compliant to guidelines
- Interacting with a range of stakeholders of different seniorities
- Supporting with UX topics and analysis where required

SKILLS, EXPERIENCE & REQUIRED ATTRIBUTES:
- Ideally you would be a recent graduate with a marketing/business-related degree or marketing experience, preferably Digital Marketing but this is not essential
- Interested and building around AI
- Some HTML and CSS experience/knowledge would be ideal however not essential
- You will have a keen interest and understanding of Digital Marketing
- Microsoft Office and Outlook understanding is essential
- You show great attention to detail, enthusiasm & willingness to learn
- A good team player and you are adaptable to change
- Present excellent communication and organisational skills

If this sounds like an ideal opportunity for you to develop your Digital Marketing career, please get in touch!

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Join a growing consumer brand in as a Digital Marketing Executive where you'll take ownership of email marketing, social media, website content and e-commerce activity, while helping deliver engaging campaigns and product launches. This is an excellent opportunity for a creative, data-driven marketer looking to make a visible impact, develop a diverse skillset and play a key role in the growth of an exciting brand.

Client Details

Our client is an ambitious and growing consumer brand with an exciting product portfolio and a reputation for quality, innovation and creativity. With a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences, it's an excellent opportunity for someone looking to join a business where they can take ownership, contribute fresh ideas and grow their career.

Description

As a Digital Marketing Executive the key responsibilities will be:
- Lead the day-to-day execution of digital marketing activity across multiple online channels.
- Plan, build and optimise customer communications that drive engagement, retention and online sales.
- Create compelling digital content that supports brand awareness, customer acquisition and product visibility.
- Manage the delivery of paid and organic social campaigns, ensuring activity aligns with wider business objectives.
- Maintain an engaging online presence by keeping digital platforms and customer touchpoints up to date.
- Use campaign and audience data to identify trends, measure success and recommend improvements.
- Support the delivery of new product launches, promotional activity and seasonal marketing initiatives.
- Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure marketing activity is coordinated and delivered effectively.
- Monitor customer behaviour and online performance to enhance the digital customer journey.
- Produce regular insight reports to help shape future marketing strategy and investment decisions.
- Contribute creative ideas for campaigns, content and customer engagement initiatives.
- Help strengthen brand visibility and customer loyalty through consistent and effective digital communications.

Profile

A successful Digital Marketing Executive should have:
- Experience in a digital, marketing, content or communications-focused role.
- Strong written communication skills with the ability to create engaging customer-facing content.
- Comfortable juggling multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
- Commercially aware with an interest in how marketing activity drives business performance.
- Confident using data and insights to inform decisions and optimise campaigns.
- Naturally proactive, organised and able to work independently when required.
- Collaborative team player who enjoys building relationships across different functions.
- Passion for consumer brands, customer engagement and digital marketing trends.

Job Offer
- Permanent role based in Berkshire.
- Competitive Salary, dependent on the level of experience.
- Benefits to be confirmed.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant

Location: Windsor

Recruitment Agency: CTR Select

Salary: £30,000 per annum.

CTR Select is recruiting on behalf of a local client for a creative and proactive Marketing Assistant to join their established marketing team in Windsor. Office based working Monday to Friday 9am - 5.30pm.

This is a varied, hands-on role offering the opportunity to work across digital marketing, social media, content creation, graphic design, PR and events.

Working closely with the Head of Marketing, you will help deliver engaging marketing campaigns, maintain brand consistency and support marketing activity across the wider business.

Key Responsibilities
- Create, design and coordinate marketing materials, including brochures, leaflets, advertisements and digital content.
- Manage social media activity, including creating, writing and scheduling engaging posts using Sprout Social or similar platforms.
- Maintain and update website content, working alongside external digital agencies.
- Support the delivery of digital marketing campaigns, including PPC and online content.
- Liaise with external design, marketing and web agencies to coordinate projects and meet deadlines.
- Support marketing events, new location launches and promotional activity.
- Produce press releases and identify PR opportunities.
- Work with HR and Recruitment teams on recruitment marketing campaigns and materials.
- Monitor campaign performance and prepare marketing reports.
- Ensure all marketing communications are accurate and consistent with brand guidelines.

About You

We are looking for someone who is creative, organised and confident working across a variety of marketing channels.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a marketing or marketing executive role.
- Good design skills and experience creating professional marketing materials and visual content.
- Experience using graphic design software, ideally Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience managing social media accounts and scheduling content.
- A good understanding of digital marketing and social media platforms.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- Excellent attention to detail and a good eye for visual presentation.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Excel.

The Opportunity

Based in Windsor, this is primarily an office-based position, with occasional travel to other locations for events, photoshoots and meetings.

If you are a creative marketing professional with strong design skills who enjoys producing engaging content and delivering varied marketing campaigns, we'd love to hear from you.

If this Marketing Assistant role is of interest to you, please click apply or contact Marie Spratley in our Egham office.

title: Marketing Assistant - Digital Content & Campaigns
description:
An excellent opportunity to kick-start your marketing career!

Are you a recent graduate or college leaver looking to start a career in B2 B marketing? Do you enjoy writing, creating digital content, researching information and keeping things organised?

We're looking for an enthusiastic and organised Marketing Assistant to join a growing international B2 B business, supporting its Group Marketing team across website content, social media, email campaigns and wider marketing activities.

This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for someone keen to develop their digital marketing skills, gain hands-on experience and learn how marketing operates within an international business environment.

The Role

Working closely with the Head of Marketing and wider team, you'll help ensure that digital content, marketing communications and campaign materials are accurate, engaging and delivered on time.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Creating and updating website content, including product information, manufacturer pages and landing pages.
- Researching and gathering information, copy and images from internal teams and external suppliers.
- Writing, editing and proofreading content to ensure accuracy and consistency.
- Supporting website optimisation, including page formatting, metadata, internal links and basic SEO.
- Helping manage the company's digital media library, keeping images and marketing assets organised and up to date.
- Supporting the LinkedIn content calendar, preparing posts, coordinating approvals and scheduling content.
- Building, testing and sending email newsletters and marketing campaigns.
- Monitoring basic campaign performance and helping identify opportunities to improve content.
- Assisting with exhibitions, supplier events, presentations and wider marketing projects.

You'll gain exposure to a broad range of marketing activities, with plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and take on more responsibility as you grow.

About You

We're interested in someone with the right attitude, enthusiasm and potential rather than extensive experience.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Recently graduated or completed college, with an interest in pursuing a career in B2 B marketing.
- A qualification or relevant studies in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Media or a similar subject.
- Strong written English and confidence in drafting and proofreading content.
- Good research skills and an eye for detail.
- Confidence using digital tools and the ability to pick up new systems quickly.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
- An interest in websites, social media, email marketing and digital content.
- A creative eye for presentation, imagery and layout.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines and multiple tasks.

You'll be curious, proactive and keen to learn, with a positive attitude and the confidence to communicate with colleagues across different teams.

An interest in technology, engineering or technical products would be beneficial, although no previous engineering knowledge is required.

Occasional travel to exhibitions, company locations and supplier meetings may be required.

A driving licence would be advantageous but is not essential.

If you're looking for your first opportunity in marketing and want to build a varied and rewarding career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Campaign Manager
description:
Are you an experienced campaign marketing professional who thrives on creating and delivering impactful multi-channel campaigns that drive customer engagement and commercial growth?

Do you enjoy turning customer insights and market trends into strategic marketing activity while working with stakeholders across multiple business functions?

Are you confident managing complex projects, optimising campaign performance, and using data to influence marketing decisions?

If you can answer yes to the above questions, then this could be the PERFECT role for you!

Reed Marketing & Creative are currently working with a leading organisation who are looking for a Marketing Campaign Manager to join their growing marketing team.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and deliver integrated marketing campaigns that align with customer, commercial, and brand objectives.
- Create campaign plans that drive customer acquisition, retention, loyalty, and long-term engagement.
- Work collaboratively with teams across digital marketing, CRM, content, social media, ecommerce, retail operations, and merchandising to deliver joined-up campaigns.
- Use customer insights, market trends, and performance data to shape marketing strategies and campaign activity.
- Take ownership of campaign timelines, objectives, KPIs, and measurement frameworks to ensure successful execution.
- Analyse campaign results and performance metrics, identifying opportunities to improve effectiveness and maximise return on investment.
- Lead the delivery of high-profile marketing initiatives, ensuring all activity is completed on time and to a high standard.
- Manage relationships with external agencies, suppliers, and partners to support campaign delivery.
- Drive continuous improvement by reviewing marketing processes, introducing best practice, and championing innovation.
- Provide clear recommendations and performance insights to senior stakeholders to help shape future marketing activity.
- Support budget planning and ensure campaign spend is managed effectively against business objectives.

The successful candidate will:
- Have significant experience within campaign marketing, integrated marketing, or customer engagement roles.
- Demonstrate a proven track record of developing and delivering successful omnichannel marketing campaigns.
- Have strong knowledge of CRM, customer lifecycle marketing, digital marketing, and customer engagement strategies.
- Be highly analytical, with experience using campaign performance data to drive decision-making and optimisation.
- Have strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance customer needs and business objectives.
- Demonstrate excellent organisation, prioritisation, and project management skills.
- Be proactive, solutions-focused, and comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience within retail, consumer, ecommerce, or other customer-focused sectors would be highly advantageous.

In return you will receive:

A competitive salary plus hybrid working, excellent benefits, and the opportunity to join a successful and growing organisation where you'll have genuine influence over marketing strategy, campaign performance, and customer engagement.

If you are keen to know more about this fantastic opportunity as a Marketing Campaign Manager, please click on the link to apply! Alternatively, you can get in touch with Bianca Halliburton at Reed Marketing & Creative in Reading.

title: Marketing Campaign Manager
company: Reeta Vickers Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
This isn't a role where you'll simply brief an agency and wait for the results. You'll take ownership of integrated marketing campaigns, bringing together creative thinking, commercial objectives and customer insight to deliver activity that makes a genuine impact.

If you enjoy the combination of strategy, hands-on campaign delivery and working with multiple teams to get things moving, this could be right up your street.

The Role

You'll be responsible for planning, developing and delivering integrated marketing campaigns across retail, ecommerce and digital channels.

Working closely with CRM, content, social media, ecommerce, merchandising and store operations teams, you'll ensure campaigns are delivered effectively, on time and with measurable results.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Leading the planning and execution of integrated, multichannel marketing campaigns.
- Developing campaign strategies aligned with customer engagement and commercial growth objectives.
- Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders to deliver consistent campaigns across online and offline channels.
- Analysing campaign performance, identifying opportunities for improvement and using data to shape future activity.
- Managing campaign budgets and ensuring marketing investment delivers value.
- Coordinating external agencies and cross-functional projects.
- Supporting and coaching a Campaign Marketing Executive.
- Ensuring campaigns are commercially focused, customer-led and delivered to a high standard.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in speaking with commercially minded marketers who can balance creative thinking with strong campaign execution.

You'll ideally bring:
- Proven experience managing integrated marketing campaigns from concept through to delivery.
- A solid understanding of CRM, digital marketing and customer lifecycle activity.
- Experience delivering campaigns across multiple channels, ideally including retail and ecommerce.
- Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities.
- Confidence managing budgets, analysing performance and reporting on results.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Experience working with external agencies and internal creative or digital teams.
- A proactive, organised approach with the confidence to take ownership.

Previous experience within retail, beauty, FMCG or another consumer-focused industry would be advantageous, although we're equally interested in transferable experience.

Experience mentoring or managing junior marketing colleagues would also be beneficial.

Apply with your CV or contact Reeta Vickers Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

Reeta Vickers Recruitment is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. Applications are welcomed from candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
We are seeking a proactive and organised Marketing Executive for a six-month temporary contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on marketer to support a varied programme of B2 B marketing activity across events, digital campaigns, content and sales enablement, working closely with internal teams, external agencies and channel partners across the EMEA region.

As a Marketing Executive, your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinate trade shows, product demonstrations and exhibitions, managing logistics, displays, promotional materials and attendee communications.
- Support product launches and lead-generation campaigns from planning through to reporting.
- Develop marketing materials, including brochures, datasheets, presentations and point-of-sale displays, while supporting communications with distributors and local partners.
- Manage email newsletters and EMEA campaigns using HubSpot, including automation, lead capture and reporting.
- Contribute to articles, case studies, blog posts and PR activities.
- Monitor marketing budgets and report on campaign and event performance, working closely with sales teams and external agencies to deliver effective marketing activity.

About You
- Experience in B2 B marketing, ideally within technology, or a similar industry, with a background in organising trade shows or events.
- Hands-on HubSpot experience, including email campaigns, marketing automation workflows and reporting.
- Good working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud and/or Figma, alongside strong Microsoft Office skills.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently and as part of a team.

If you are a versatile marketer who enjoys delivering practical, results-driven campaigns and thrives in a varied role, we would love to hear from you.

title: Part Time Marketing & Design Executive
description:
Part Time Marketing & Design Executive - Monday to Wednesday
Langley, Berkshire Office-based
Are you a talented Graphic Designer with a strong marketing mindset who enjoys getting stuck into a wide variety of creative projects?
An ambitious and growing UK product-led brand is looking for a Marketing & Design Executive to join its in-house team and take ownership of a broad range of creative and marketing activity.
This is a genuinely hands-on role where you'll be responsible for producing high-quality work across print, digital, website content, product communications, point-of-sale and advertising.
The Role
Working closely with management, sales and product teams, you'll help ensure the brand is presented consistently, professionally and creatively across every customer touchpoint.
No two days will be the same. You could be:
- Designing a brochure or promotional campaign
- Creating artwork for billboards and outdoor advertising
- Producing digital assets for websites, email campaigns and online advertising
- Updating product ranges and content on the website
- Creating technical specification sheets and product literature
- Preparing artwork for print and external suppliers
- Supporting new product and range launches
- Editing and preparing product photography
- Creating sales presentations and marketing materials
- Supporting exhibitions, showroom events and customer activity
- Working with external agencies, photographers, printers and suppliers

You'll have genuine ownership of the day-to-day creative output and the opportunity to make a visible impact on how the brand develops and grows.
About You
We're looking for someone who combines strong graphic design skills with excellent organisation, attention to detail and commercial awareness.
You'll ideally have:
- Strong graphic design skills and an impressive portfolio
- Excellent knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop
- Experience producing print-ready artwork
- Experience managing and updating website content
- Experience creating brochures, catalogues or technical/product literature
- Good knowledge of image editing and preparation for web and print
- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly with product codes, measurements and technical information
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects at once
- Excellent written English and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and take projects from brief through to completion

Experience within an in-house design/marketing team, creative agency or product-led business would be beneficial.

What's On Offer
This is an exciting opportunity to join an ambitious, growing business with a strong focus on product design, innovation and colour.
You'll have the opportunity to become an important part of the in-house team, with genuine ownership and visibility across the business.
Rather than being restricted to one area of marketing, you'll work across the full creative spectrum - from new product launches and technical literature to brochures, websites and national advertising campaigns.
If you're a creative, commercially minded designer who enjoys variety, works quickly and accurately, and takes real pride in how a brand looks and communicates, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales and Marketing Coordinator
description:
Sales and Marketing Coordinator

Temporary Contract Minimum 2 Months

Location: Maidenhead
Working Pattern: 2 days per week in the office, with regular travel to regional sites

The Opportunity

Are you a creative, organised individual with a passion for marketing and communications?

We are working with an established and highly regarded UK business to recruit a Group Sales & Marketing Coordinator to support its national marketing function.

Reporting to the National Marketing Manager, you'll play an important role in supporting a variety of marketing activities across the Group, combining digital marketing, customer communications, systems support and administration.

This is a fantastic opportunity to broaden your marketing experience, develop your digital skills and gain exposure to CRM systems, customer engagement platforms and exciting marketing projects.

What you'll be doing

You'll enjoy a varied role with responsibilities including:
- CRM & Digital Marketing: Supporting CRM, email marketing, SMS and customer engagement platforms.
- Campaign Coordination: Creating email templates and checking regional campaigns for accuracy and brand consistency.
- Content & Communications: Writing and proofreading marketing materials, customer communications and digital content.
- Customer Journeys: Helping to set up and test automated campaigns and customer journeys.
- Website & Systems: Carrying out website and system testing, identifying issues and coordinating fixes.
- Digital Content: Supporting customer communications, corporate video channels and online content.

- Team Support: Providing general administrative assistance, including invoice coding and project coordination.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and enjoys working in a varied marketing support role.

You'll ideally bring:
- Experience in a marketing, communications, digital or administrative position.
- Excellent written English, with strong copywriting and proofreading skills.
- A keen eye for detail and the ability to produce clear, engaging content.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook and Teams.
- Confidence working with systems, data and digital platforms.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach.

Desirable Experience

Experience using Salesforce, MoEngage, website content management systems or digital marketing platforms would be advantageous, but is by no means essential.

A marketing-related qualification would also be beneficial, although relevant experience and the right attitude are equally important.

title: Sales and Marketing Coordinator
description:
Sales and Marketing Coordinator

Temporary Contract Minimum 2 Months

Location: Maidenhead
Working Pattern: 2 days per week in the office, with regular travel to regional sites

The Opportunity

Are you a creative, organised individual with a passion for marketing and communications?

We are working with an established and highly regarded UK business to recruit a Group Sales & Marketing Coordinator to support its national marketing function.

Reporting to the National Marketing Manager, you'll play an important role in supporting a variety of marketing activities across the Group, combining digital marketing, customer communications, systems support and administration.

This is a fantastic opportunity to broaden your marketing experience, develop your digital skills and gain exposure to CRM systems, customer engagement platforms and exciting marketing projects.

What you'll be doing

You'll enjoy a varied role with responsibilities including:
- CRM & Digital Marketing: Supporting CRM, email marketing, SMS and customer engagement platforms.
- Campaign Coordination: Creating email templates and checking regional campaigns for accuracy and brand consistency.
- Content & Communications: Writing and proofreading marketing materials, customer communications and digital content.
- Customer Journeys: Helping to set up and test automated campaigns and customer journeys.
- Website & Systems: Carrying out website and system testing, identifying issues and coordinating fixes.
- Digital Content: Supporting customer communications, corporate video channels and online content.
- Marketing Resources: Maintaining guidance documents, marketing resources and intranet content.
- Team Support: Providing general administrative assistance, including invoice coding and project coordination.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and enjoys working in a varied marketing support role.

- Experience in a marketing, communications, digital or administrative position.

- A keen eye for detail and the ability to produce clear, engaging content.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook and Teams.
- Confidence working with systems, data and digital platforms.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach.

Desirable Experience

Experience using Salesforce, MoEngage, website content management systems or digital marketing platforms would be advantageous, but is by no means essential.

A marketing-related qualification would also be beneficial, although relevant experience and the right attitude are equally important.

title: Senior E-Commerce & Marketing Executive
description:
Senior E-Commerce & Marketing Executive - 12-Month Maternity Cover Newbury (Hybrid 3 days in office) - £36-42 K pro rata

We are working with an exciting and growing consumer food and drink business to recruit a Senior E-Commerce & Marketing Executive on a 12-month maternity cover contract.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established yet entrepreneurial FMCG business, taking responsibility for delivering its digital commerce and consumer marketing activity across a portfolio of brands.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on e-commerce and digital marketing professional with strong Shopify and Klaviyo experience, ideally gained within the food and drink sector.

The Role

You will play a key role in managing and developing the company's e-commerce platforms, delivering digital marketing campaigns and driving online brand performance.

Working alongside internal teams, creative agencies and external partners, your responsibilities will include:
- Delivering agreed digital commerce and consumer marketing plans across a portfolio of consumer brands.
- Managing and developing Shopify websites, including website content, merchandising, optimisation and ongoing development.
- Planning, creating and delivering email marketing campaigns and newsletters using Klaviyo.
- Managing SEO activity in collaboration with an external agency.
- Coordinating Amazon content, optimisation and advertising through agency partners.
- Managing retailer and wholesaler digital media activity across relevant platforms.
- Planning and executing consumer marketing campaigns, brand collaborations and promotional activity.
- Briefing and managing creative agencies and designers on artwork and content development.
- Managing paid social campaigns and coordinating organic social media activity.
- Liaising with the e-commerce fulfilment partner and monitoring stock levels to support effective online operations.
- Identifying opportunities to use AI tools to improve marketing workflows, content development and productivity.

About You

We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on digital marketing professional who enjoys working across the full e-commerce and marketing mix.

You will ideally have:
- Strong practical experience managing Shopify websites and Klaviyo email marketing both essential.
- Experience within the food and drink / FMCG sector- essential.
- Good understanding of e-commerce, SEO and wider digital marketing.
- Experience managing Amazon content, optimisation and/or advertising.
- Experience briefing and managing creative and artwork development.
- Confidence managing external agencies, suppliers and commercial partners.
- Good copywriting skills, particularly for email campaigns and digital content.
- Practical experience using AI tools to enhance marketing, e-commerce and content workflows.
- Experience with Citrus or other retailer digital media platforms would be advantageous.

What's on Offer?

Salary of £36,000 £42,000, depending on experience.

12-month maternity cover contract.

Full-time opportunity.

Free on-site parking.

The opportunity to take ownership of a varied e-commerce and consumer marketing role within an established FMCG business.

Interested?

If you have hands-on Shopify and Klaviyo experience and are looking for an exciting opportunity within the food and drink sector, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Our client is a growing and ambitious company working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple sectors. They are seeking a creative and organised Social Media Executive to join their team, taking ownership of day-to-day social media activity across a range of client accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys content creation, community management and using data to drive performance.

Company Benefits:
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Additional birthday day off when it falls on a weekday.
- Discretionary annual bonus.
- Benefits package including employer pension contributions and healthcare.
- Professional development support and training budget.
- Friendly and collaborative team environment with regular social events.
- Long-term career progression opportunities.
- Flexibility around appointments and occasional personal commitments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing day-to-day social media activity across a portfolio of client accounts.
- Creating and implementing content calendars aligned to client objectives and campaign strategies.
- Writing engaging social media copy and coordinating the creation of visual content across multiple platforms.
- Scheduling and publishing content while ensuring brand consistency and platform best practice.
- Managing community engagement, responding to comments, messages and online interactions.
- Monitoring audience feedback, identifying trends and escalating sensitive issues where required.
- Producing performance reports and providing actionable insights to improve content effectiveness.
- Using data and analytics to optimise content, engagement and overall account performance.
- Supporting client communications, content approvals and campaign delivery.
- Coordinating content creation, photography and video requirements where necessary.
- Collaborating with internal teams to ensure social media activity is integrated into wider marketing initiatives.
- Keeping up to date with social media trends, platform developments and emerging opportunities.

Experience and Skills Requirements
- 2-3 years' experience within a social media, digital marketing or content-focused role.
- Strong copywriting skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience managing multiple social media accounts and content calendars.
- Good understanding of major social media platforms and best practices.
- Experience using social media scheduling, management and reporting tools.
- Ability to interpret data and translate performance metrics into actionable recommendations.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Creative, proactive and commercially aware approach.
- Genuine enthusiasm for social media, digital marketing and industry trends.

If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted.
